text:
Jordan: PulseCare reporting P1 — embedding p99 latency jumped ~120ms -> 1.5s and error rate +3%. They see timeouts hitting the dedicated pool. Need short-term mitigation and clear owners. Any volunteers? @priya @samir @alex

Priya: I'm on logs + eval. dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/pulsecare-embeds :eyes: Can someone check routing for the dedicated pool? last deploy was model:v2 yesterday 22:40 UTC

Samir: I can take the rollback path. PR #4821 rolled model:v2 -> live. I can revert to model:v1 and push a canary. ETA ~45m if no infra blockers. pinging eng-sre for traffic swap

Alex: Looking at autoscale & routing now. dedicated-pool "dedicated-pulsecare-1" has high queue depth; temporary routing to shared pool makes sense. I'll run a route override. Command I'm planning:
```
curl -X POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN\" \
  https://control-plane.local/api/v1/route-override \
  -d '{"customer":"pulsecare","from":"dedicated-pulsecare-1","to":"shared-pool-2","mode":"drain"}'
```
If Samir confirms rollback I'll coordinate the swap. :thumbsup:

Claire: CS has told customer we're investigating and asked for ETA for a workaround + next update in 1h. Please confirm comms once we have an owner

opsbot: Incident created: INC-20260309-7682 — severity P1. Channel #inc-7682-pulsecare created. Pager duty pinged oncall.

Jordan: Assigning owners: mitigation = Samir (rollback), routing/drain = Alex, monitoring/logs = Priya, comms = Claire. Short plan: rollback canary in 1h, traffic drain within 1h30, full revert if stable in 6h. React with :white_check_mark: if you agree

Samir: :white_check_mark: starting rollback now. Will update PR and post progress. If rollback is blocked, fallback = route override only

Priya: Logs streaming. Noticed KV cache miss rate spiking for this keyspace — adding temporary cache-bypass rule for embeddings to reduce regen. ETA 20m

Alex: Route override started, running health checks against shared-pool-2. Posting probes and status shortly.

Jordan: Thanks — ping me if infra escalation needed and I'll loop in @sanjay. Next update at +30m or sooner.
